limits: Real existing Device visits UI and native local synthetic Worker/D1 only. No D04 runtime or encrypted Routine save was built.
Desktop Chromium at390x844 is browser emulation; it does not certify supported Android3GB RAM/4 cores/storage or physical power-loss durability.
CDP latency/throughput values are declared browser network surrogates, not a calibrated physical300ms/800ms round-trip network.
Degraded loss is declared deterministic abortion of every97th actual /api/ request; no successful response bodies are substituted.

Warm local intervals begin at real trusted input/click before application clone/queue, include commit/ack/usable DOM and instrumentation overhead; exact readback is separately verified outside the endpoint.
PBKDF2 derives once during actual unlock; the observer derives a readback key once outside intervals. No claim that cold unlock/setup is within500ms.
Cached Today is the existing prepared device queue, not all assigned tasks; every Patient/Today presentation appends real encrypted access evidence.
Connected intervals include real no-store JSON body validation and exact person/visit usable DOM plus browser automation overhead; no header-only endpoint.
After origin interception is installed, CDP restores native HTTP cache for public assets; actual cache diagnostics are retained and no-store API cache hits are refused.
Sequential single-browser samples do not satisfy R1 capacity:100 concurrent users/100000 people/50requests-per-second/30minutes.
All actual timed failures/timeouts contribute observed durations and error findings; successful-only percentiles are separate. No extra successful samples replace failed fixed1000 attempts.
Zero unexplained errors is the declared conservative local-control budget, not an invented formal BRD approval. Injected degraded errors stay in distributions and numerical ceiling comparisons.
